name: Neural Maze
storyline:
You are taken to a hospital by police officers who caught you, naked, shouting ‘I love pineapple pizza’.
It’s obvious that you’re losing brain cells.
The doctor who admits you allows you to control your diseased brain cells using a microscope.
To treat yourself, you’ll need to control one, but more often two, neurons at the same time, navigating increasingly tortuous paths.
These paths will be reversed, flipped, or made invisible, and your controls will change direction, sometimes right in the middle of a path.
Do you have the nerves of steel to see Neural Maze through to the end?
Thanks to ‘Party’ mode, you can challenge your friends and family and finally find out who has the best control of their gamepad.
summary: 2 neurons. 2 joysticks. One brain must control both at the same time: yours. Guide your lost neurons through increasingly convoluted mazes – reversed controls, power cuts, memory mode – under the watchful eye of an overwhelmed doctor. Is your brain ready?
